display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (Non-Supine): (Apneas with >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal) / hour of sleep in non-supine position from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in non-supine body position (>= 2% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hrop2 + hnrop2 + carop2 + canop2 + oarop2 + oanop2 + marop2 + manrop2)/(remepop+nremepop)
